_readme: Candidate local models per role. YOU MAY EDIT THIS FILE (add, remove or change entries). It is a list of models worth TESTING, not a recommendation: a model gets a role only after it passes that role's test pack on this machine (see SKILL.md (local-model policy)). Sizes are download sizes as shown on the runner's library pages on the date below; the library pages did not show a licence for most entries, so licence is marked 'check' where it was not seen. If this list is out of date, nothing breaks: the bake-off is the judge, and a model that is gone or too big simply fails or does not fit.
list_checked_how: Ollama library pages fetched on that date (ollama.com/library and the pages of each model named below). Relative update dates only were shown; no exact release dates.

runner.name: ollama
runner.why: Installs for the current user without administrator rights on Windows (the installer puts it in the user's home folder; models go to the user's .ollama folder, movable with the OLLAMA_MODELS variable). Local API at http://localhost:11434, JSON-schema constrained output, embeddings. Needs an NVIDIA driver of version 551.61 or newer on Windows to use an NVIDIA GPU (from the runner's Windows page, checked 2026-11-18).
runner.windows: Download OllamaSetup.exe from ollama.com/download and run it as the normal user. No administrator prompt is expected.
runner.macos: Download Ollama.dmg, drag the app to Applications, start it once. It may ask to create a link in /usr/local/bin (that asks for administrator approval). macOS 14 or newer. Apple silicon uses the GPU; Intel Macs run on the CPU only.
runner.linux: The official install script and the manual package both need sudo. Without administrator rights this skill's local-model features are not available through the supported route: Claude does those roles instead. (A home-folder install was not tested.)
runner.how_the_skill_checks: detect_machine.py asks the local server for its version (GET /api/version) and its installed models (GET /api/tags), and falls back to running `ollama --version` and `ollama list`. A model counts as present only if the runner lists it.

rerank.note: Default: keyword ranking, fused with embedding ranking when an embed model is qualified. No model needed.

rerank.id: pointwise:<a model from the extract pool>
rerank.note: The runner's library showed no reranker model on 2026-11-18 (only community uploads, which the shipped scripts cannot call). Option: a small generative model scores each passage 0 to 3 for relevance. Optional; test against the baseline.

not_attempted_on_small_machines.what: Vision and OCR models (reading scanned pages and figures)
not_attempted_on_small_machines.why: Image input needs extra memory beyond the text weights, and OCR output needs the two-reader check, which is not affordable on a 6 GB card. Scanned papers are marked scanned_no_text and need a text version or a person.
